summary: Web project with service cards section. Removing slider/carousel UI controls (circular arrow button, pagination dots, 1/8 counter) and converting to normal vertically stacked scrollable cards with no swipe, snap, or hidden overflow.
architectural_notes: Services section uses normal vertical stacked cards — no slider, no carousel, no swipe, no snap, no hidden overflow

existing_features.title: In the ServiceCarousel component, remove the circular up/down arrow navigation button, the pagination dots indicator, and the '1 / 8' counter text entirely from the rendered output.

Remove all carousel/slider logic from ServiceCarousel: eliminate touch/swipe event handlers, scroll-snap, hidden overflow, and any state tracking for the active slide index. Convert the component to a simple vertically stacked list of service category cards with normal block flow.

Preserve the visual appearance of each service category card exactly: keep the card images, titles, descriptions, 'View Services' links, card design, colors, fonts, and spacing between cards unchanged.
